summary: Stopped at fixed hard stop 1 before implementation: mandatory documentation deliverables fall outside the owned-path allowlist. Only explicitly required stopping artifacts were written. Build, format, fast tests, and replay were not run; their gates are not claimed. The head identifies the clean checkout assessed before the stopping-artifacts commit.

deviations.why: Fixed hard stop 1 applies because required reports cannot be created within the fixed owned-path allowlist.

findings: The fixed owned-path allowlist excludes dotnet/docs/** despite mandatory reports, log, improvements register, and finish status residing there.
Stage 4 names improvements/W1-skeleton.json, while the fixed rules name improvements/skeleton.json.

needs_human.item: Authorize the required skeleton documentation paths in both the task allowlist and the owned_paths gate.
needs_human.why: The mandatory deliverables otherwise trigger fixed hard stop 1; the missing-decision policy cannot change fixed rules.
The task specifies two different filenames.
